description: EPark Event Parking Schedule is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset contains the current and historic record of days/nights when the EPark Event Parking rates were scheduled and any corresponding messaging that may accompany these instances. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Events. Its tags are event parking rates, event parking schedule. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
